problem: The XiaoYu repository is now public and is developed through both the product branch and agent/** branches. GitHub public-repository secret scanning provides platform detection, but the existing XiaoYu machine gate had no explicit repository-visible secret scanner step for every agent/product push.

selected.baseline: GitHub public-repository secret scanning and user push protection
selected.integration: one step in the existing private-overlay workflow after full-history checkout and before reuse/architecture gates
selected.permissions: existing contents: read; PR comments and SARIF artifact upload disabled

rejected: second secret-scanning workflow with a separate trigger surface
requiring a Gitleaks organization license for this personal-account repository
acceptance: gitleaks/gitleaks-action@v3 runs for the same product and agent/** push triggers as the reuse/architecture gate
the secret gate executes before reuse/architecture implementation checks
PR commenting is disabled so contents: read remains sufficient for the XiaoYu gate
artifact upload is disabled; secrets must not be copied into CI artifacts
retirement_condition: Retire the external Gitleaks step only if repository-level GitHub secret protection/push protection becomes machine-verifiably enforced for every product and agent push with equivalent historical/current detection and the XiaoYu gate can prove that protection.
